days.title: Religious History and Rock Art
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: grotto
stops.detail: The inhabitants of the time erected a Christian place of worship with a grotto, a grave and an artistic relief depicting a biblical scene.

stops.name: Descent from the Cross
stops.detail: Today, this relief of the Descent from the Cross is considered a work of art of European significance.
